report.root_cause: The /dev/loop2 ext4 uploads mount at /home/ubuntu/wordpress/wp-content/uploads is reported at 99.92%, but the available evidence cannot determine whether this reflects actual disk consumption, a mount-state issue, or a metric artifact; no writer or trigger is identified.

ruled_out.hypothesis: H1: A log/cache write flood on nginx filled its mounted filesystem.
H2: A recent nginx config/deploy change caused unusual writes or runaway file generation.

ranked.root_cause: The loop2 uploads filesystem is genuinely full due to an unidentified writer; the current evidence does not identify the process or mechanism.
The loop2 uploads mount or its disk metric is transiently remounted or reporting an artifact, causing the repeated full reading.
